The '''People's Tower''' was a building located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[New Adasta]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]]. It was styled after the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Imperial Citadel]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. During the [[Invasion of Ziost]], [[Lana Beniko]] and [[Theron Shan]] used the Tower's systems to generate a massive [[Electrostatic gun|electrostatic blast]], freeing New Adasta's populace from [[Tenebrae|Vitiate's]] control&mdash;though only for a short time.
